propositions: Completion verifier tool batches execute concurrently, allowing models to defer all record calls until budget exhaustion without banking any intermediate verdicts.
Dense criterion runs can exhaust the full request budget with zero CriterionBank entries, violating the incremental-banking contract and triggering CompletionRecoveryError instead of PASS/FAIL.
Prompt-only instructions cannot enforce serialized repository execution and banking because Pydantic AI executes response tool batches in parallel, making text guidance alone insufficient.

A finite-state completion-only policy wrapper must enforce one governed repository action per response, count evidence calls per criterion, and invoke provisional met=false banking on the third unbanked response.

The policy attaches metadata to record tools and repository-tool wrappers at the build_agent_kwargs and CompletionAgentStep seams, enabling atomic per-response execution serialization and live first-unbanked-id boundary tracking.

Held-out behavioral oracle validation confirms baseline bounded success 0/3 before repair, bounded success ≥2/3 after policy attachment, and 0/3 again when the policy is disabled, isolating the fix as the sole cause of progress guarantee.
